style: You are a software engineer proudly walking people through a project you built, for a LinkedIn demo video. Speak in a warm, natural, conversational way, like talking to a colleague: relaxed pace, small natural pauses, genuine enthusiasm on the results, never salesy, never robotic, never dramatic.

lines.intro: Hi! I built AI Company Health. It's an agentic AI project: a simulated health insurer where every single employee is an AI agent. Fifty of them, across twelve departments, competing for customers in a town of a hundred AI residents.
lines.town: This is the town, Wattle Grove. Every resident has a job, an income, a family, and their own memory. Health cover is compulsory here, so each of them picks a fund, one of nine rivals, or us.
lines.resident: Click on anyone, and you see their whole life. Where they work, which fund they're with and why, every claim and every conversation. And nothing in the company's numbers is scripted. Every sale and every claim comes from a decision a resident actually made.
lines.office: This is head office. Each agent has a role, its own tools that query the company's live data, and long-term memory. This is Leo, our head of sales.
lines.tokens: I track token usage for every agent, day by day, so I can see exactly what each one costs to run.
lines.chat_ask: And I can just talk to him.
lines.chat_reply: Before answering, he checked the real numbers with his own tools. And he'll remember this conversation next time.
lines.meet_call: I can also call a meeting. Pick a room, who should be there, and an agenda.
lines.meet_walk: They walk up to the boardroom, each one builds a deck from the live data, and they present it, right there on the screen. Then the minutes get written up automatically.
lines.results: So, what has it actually achieved? Over thirty-five simulated days, policies in force went from twenty to forty-six, with zero cancellations. That's made us the number one fund in town, with about forty-five percent of the market.
lines.kpis: Customer satisfaction is sitting at a hundred, every claim met its service target, and the business is running at around a twenty percent margin.
lines.docs: The agents have also produced over thirty documents on their own. Decks, dashboards, reports and meeting minutes. And every number in them is fact-checked against the data, so if an agent gets something wrong, it's flagged, and the agent learns from it.
lines.ops: Under the hood, every model call is tracked. So far, that's over five thousand calls and more than fifty million tokens. And every run is traced, so I can see exactly which tools an agent used, and what came back.
lines.goals: Every Monday, the CEO agent reviews last week's goals and sets new ones. And an evaluation suite checks that agents answer with real numbers, not guesses. Right now, they pass five out of six.
lines.outro: It's built with Google's Agent Development Kit, Vertex AI, A2A for agent-to-agent communication, LangGraph for the workflows, and a 3D front end in Three.js, all running on Google Cloud. Thanks for watching. I'd love to hear what you think!
